about_the_game:
Start your Legacy with personality and flair.

Abigail is now available as a unique character you may encounter and recruit into your village for a limited time. She blends naturally into your recruitment pool, offering a unique personality and depth in shaping your Kingdoms Story!

Meet Abigail.

Raised in the wild by outlaws, Abigail became a skilled forager and survivalist. Rejecting her father’s violent ways, she betrayed his gang to protect innocent travelers. Pardoned for her bravery, she now seeks a new life in Greenwood. Abigail brings her sharp instincts, forest knowledge, and confident charm to your settlement, while her playful, flirty side and tavern-frequenting habits make her as entertaining as she is resourceful. She won’t guarantee success—but she might just make your village’s story more memorable.

Traits & Personality
Emotional: Flirty
Behavior: Barfly
Role: Noble

Abigail will be added to your recruitment pool and can be recruited as other villagers can. Keep an eye out.

short_description: Noble Legacy is a medieval city building game from a 3rd person perspective. With the depth of city building simulation games and the immersiveness of 3rd person RPGs, Noble Legacy will deliver on the power fantasy to “Be the ruler of a medieval kingdom.”
